record.label: G3 co-fire package (banked-gain track)
record.summary: Package the proven frozen-transferable G3 supply into a fireable estimator increment: fill the value hump (L3/L6/L7 cores; retune L4), replace crude per-layer gammas with the LOO-beta consumption integration, add the k3-channel stack on the same K21r planes, verify on untouched panel nets + virgin gate, co-fire with the held f32 pack (-4.9% adj). Current measured: +1.1% raw in-sample / +0.6% frozen from 3 layers. NIGHT END STATE 2026-09-03: every candidate route closed with independent-truth receipts on both nets (frozen tables, learned k3 corrector, mechanistic features, engine-in-card, refit rounds 1-3). What stands: the card is exact with true per-layer (v, k3, k4); the open problem N0.1 with its judge and the priced memo; the virgin gate and fire tooling. 2026-09-02 14:00 BOARD ARITHMETIC after the plane dissection: deployable planes top out ~3.1e-8 (r35) / ~3.5e-8 (r100) F2J-off at ~+10% util; a refit operator on that host lands ~2.2-2.5e-8 by the two-table precedent (the plane effect is 84% in-span) -> adj ~-5% at best, unproven; the bank (1.5e-8) is out of reach of every measured piece; the goal needs truth-class planes + k3 = the 1024^4 born-content wall. Decision for Matt in HANDOFF_CURRENT.md. 2026-09-02 17:00: f32 pack confirmed on the deployed card (raw identical, util 0.600 -> 0.571 = -4.9% adj), HELD under the meaningful-fire bar. Holding for Matt's decision (HANDOFF_CURRENT.md). 2026-09-02 20:30: the goal is reachable with the operator kept (N0.1f); the DECISION_MEMO's a/b/c framing is superseded: the question is how to build an aligned half-scale (dv, dk3) supply. Board unchanged; nothing fired. 2026-09-03 02:00: Matt's bar (beat 2e-8 raw) measured as an exact requirement (T-82..T-85b); no candidate; only the f32 pack is packageable (raw identical, adj -4.9%). HANDOFF_CURRENT.md lists three options. 2026-09-03 20:00: no candidate beats the bank under adjusted = raw x util; the chain card (~2.05e-8) is retracted; only the f32 pack (1.70e-8, -4.9%) is packageable. The cubature class measures 2.2x over MC at 1024x16 (~3e-7 adjusted): the competitor's phase-2 method is different. HANDOFF_CURRENT.md 20:00 lists the two builds left.
record.terminal_criterion: Either a board submission whose adjusted gain clears the meaningful bar (>=8-10% adj including the f32 co-fire) with virgin-gate pass, or a banked honest NOGO with the measured asymptote recorded.
record.goal_path_summary: Turn the first frozen-transferable supply mechanism into banked board points while the tracker is built. The mechanism adds a few percent of raw accuracy on top of the deployed estimator by correcting its variance bookkeeping at the layers where corrections propagate most; combined with the float-precision pack it approaches the fire bar.
